purpose: Exploratory subpixel source diagnostics; no automatic source confirmation.
prf_model: Official MAST TESS PRF start_s0004, bilinear detector interpolation and subpixel interpolation from Keaton Bell TESS_PRF, pinned source and MIT license retained.
astrometry: Gaia DR3 positions propagated from J2016 to each epoch using proper motions. Fit common x/y WCS shift against the median pixel image with nonnegative stellar fluxes and free constant/linear background. Evaluate 1%, 2%, and 5% per-pixel model floors to expose registration sensitivity.
period_maps: Saved P=0.4376766017096235 d, 4 harmonics. Source diagnostic only; new period detector receives no reference period. Compare all samples with samples excluding |PDCSAP-median| > 8*MAD-scaled sigma. Do not promote an epoch that failed frozen detection.
flare_map: S36 highest good-quality PDCSAP point. Mean pixel image within +/-0.005 d of peak minus a linear interpolation of median images from [-0.5,-0.2] d and [+0.8,+1.1] d. This identifies a transient location, not necessarily the periodic source.
fits: Free source position near target, and fixed target versus fixed 5.09 arcsec neighbor hypotheses, with fitted nonnegative amplitude and free plane. Residual losses are diagnostics, not calibrated odds or significance.
validation: Synthetic PRF images at target/neighbor with imposed registration shifts check coordinate convention and fitting. Compare temporal halves, model-floor choices and source-map variants; do not interpret synthetic recovery alone as real-sky calibration.
limits: PRF calibration/model mismatch may dominate statistical precision.
Magnitude conversion is not assumed: fitted stellar amplitudes are free.
A non-detection remains a non-detection regardless of any masked diagnostic.
